name: online-open-rocket
description: Browser-based re-creation of the OpenRocket model-rocketry design and flight-simulation tool

scripts.build: node scripts/check-workspace-links.mjs && npm run build -w @online-openrocket/engine && npm run build -w @online-openrocket/app
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/check-workspace-links.mjs && npm run build -w @online-openrocket/engine && npm run typecheck -w @online-openrocket/app && npm run typecheck -w @online-openrocket/api
scripts.lint: node scripts/check-workspace-links.mjs && npm run build -w @online-openrocket/engine && eslint .
scripts.test: node scripts/check-workspace-links.mjs && npm run build -w @online-openrocket/engine && npm run test -w @online-openrocket/engine && npm run test -w @online-openrocket/app && npm run test -w @online-openrocket/api
